seen.out/storytime-review/batch-31/pages/l2-w: Orange tabby cat with white muzzle, chest and paws, big green eyes with black pupils, curled ring tail, standing three-quarter view on plain white.

1-bit line cat; tail drawn as a closed ring behind the head that reads as a second ear; forehead and leg stripes drawn as thin outlined slivers; eyes as one ring with solid pupil; no eyelash ticks although the color has them.
One bird nest, three blue eggs, plain white background, no eyes and no text.
1-bit line nest, three closed egg ovals, bold closed twig and rim lines, no eyes, no specks.
One blue and yellow fish, side view, one big eye with pupil and highlight, dorsal, tail and side fins, plain white background.
1-bit line fish, one closed body outline, eye as one ring with solid pupil, fin fan lines measured 16 to 21 px, no scales and no specks.
One brown and white puppy, red collar with gold bell, tongue out, four legs, both pupils look the same way, no text on the collar.
1-bit line puppy; each eye drawn as an outer ring plus an inner iris ring around the pupil (double rings); pupils converge inward; no tail although the color shows a raised tail.
One yellow school bus, three-quarter view, blue windows, black door frame and bumper, marker lights; zoom crops at 2x of the side, door, front and roof show no letter, number, sign, plate or logo.
1-bit line bus, bold closed outlines, no text; the door carries a horizontal divider line that the color door does not have.
One pale yellow sun hat with red band and red bow, plain white background, no eyes and no text.
1-bit line hat, closed crown, brim and band, bow drawn as five closed petals with no eyes, outline measured 26 px, clean.
One blue cup with cream rim and right-side handle, plain white background, no face and no text.
1-bit line cup, outer and inner rim ellipses plus closed handle, bold closed lines, no eyes and no specks.
One green butterfly net, hoop, mesh bag and tan handle with green grip, plain white background, no eyes and no text.
1-bit line net; hoop rim drawn as two concentric lines; mesh lines measured 11 to 14 px with big squares; no eyes and no specks.
One bird nest, three blue eggs, same element and view as the check-row nest, plain white background.
1-bit line nest, three closed eggs, bold closed lines; the rim lines carry small angular steps along the top edge at 2x zoom.
One acorn, brown cap and tan body with stem, plain white background, no eyes and no text.
1-bit line acorn, closed outline; at 3x zoom the body outline meets the cap line on the right with a small step and the cap edge is slightly wavy.
